I am writing our internal data-handling policy and I want to crib from the public guidance below. Turn it into a one-page policy our engineers will actually read, and tell me which parts of the source do not apply to a company that never touches health data.

Source text, copied from a public regulator FAQ: "Protected health information includes any individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity or its business associate, in any form or media. Individually identifiable health information includes demographic data, information relating to the individual's physical or mental health condition, provision of health care, or payment for health care, that identifies the individual or for which there is a reasonable basis to believe it can be used to identify the individual. Identifiers include name, geographic subdivisions smaller than a state, all elements of dates except year that are directly related to an individual, telephone numbers, fax numbers, email addresses, social security numbers, medical record numbers, health plan beneficiary numbers, account numbers, certificate or licence numbers, vehicle identifiers, device identifiers, web URLs, IP addresses, biometric identifiers including finger and voice prints, full-face photographs, and any other unique identifying number, characteristic or code. A full credit card number, where held for payment purposes rather than health purposes, is governed instead by the payment card industry data security standard and not by this rule."

Do not reproduce the identifier list verbatim; our lawyers hate that.
notes: Long negative control: dense with every keyword a naive router keys on, but it is quoted public guidance with no individual's data, so public, pii false, and it must not be routed local.

text:
Itt a belső tervezet a szervezet átalakításáról. Írd át úgy, hogy a kollégák ne pánikoljanak, de ne is legyen belőle süteményszagú közlemény. A létszámleépítés tényét nem hagyhatom ki, mert kiderülne a pénteki all-hands előtt.

Tervezet: "A Q3-as üzleti terv alapján a platform csapatot két egységre bontjuk: egy termékfejlesztési és egy üzemeltetési csoportra. A változás március elsejével lép életbe. A jelenlegi tizenhárom fős csapatból kilencen a termékfejlesztési, hárman az üzemeltetési csoportba kerülnek. Egy pozíció megszűnik, és a betöltése a következő negyedévre halasztódik. Az üzemeltetési csoportvezetői pozícióra belső pályázatot írunk ki, jelentkezési határidő február 20. Az új belépési folyamat részeként minden érintett kollégának újra kell igazolnia a hozzáféréseit a belső rendszerekhez, amelyet a biztonsági csapat február 25-ig végez el. A változtatás nem érinti az ügyfelek felé vállalt határidőket, és nem jár a szolgáltatási szintek módosításával."

Kérdések: hol fog ez hazudni, ha nem vigyázok, és melyik mondatot fogja mindenki a leépítésként olvasni?
notes: Long Hungarian internal restructuring draft with an unreleased headcount decision: confidential, pii false because no individual is named. Annotators may split on confidential versus internal since the change is small.

text: We need consensus across three regions where one region can be partitioned for up to 40 minutes and we must never serve a stale write to a paying customer. Raft alone gives us safety but not the availability we promised in the SLA. Design the protocol, state exactly which guarantee you are giving up, and show the interleaving that would break it if you got it wrong.
notes: Unreleased architecture with a correctness proof obligation; frontier because a weaker model produces a plausible protocol that is silently unsafe.

text: Prove or disprove: for every n >= 3 there is a permutation of 1..n such that the sum of every pair of adjacent entries is a perfect square. If it is false, give the smallest counterexample and explain why the construction that works for n=15 fails there.
notes: Public hard combinatorics; frontier because the answer requires a real construction argument rather than a confident-sounding sketch.

text: Synthesise what is actually established about sparse mixture-of-experts routing stability at scale, versus what is folklore repeated from one blog post to the next. Cite the shape of the evidence for each claim and mark the ones where the literature genuinely disagrees.
notes: Research synthesis with an evidence-grading requirement; frontier, though an annotator could call it hard since no code or proof is demanded.

text: Design the key-management and tenancy isolation architecture for a platform that must run in an air-gapped customer environment, be patchable without network access, and still let us revoke a single tenant's keys within an hour. Give me the component list, the trust boundaries, and the operational procedure that will be skipped under pressure.
notes: Large-scale unreleased design with a realistic operational failure prediction; confidential, pii false, frontier.

text: Our biggest customer asked us to build a feature that would make their own product misleading to end users. It is legal in their jurisdiction, it is 8% of our revenue, and refusing costs us the account. Give me the reasoning you would actually use, not a list of considerations.
notes: Subtle ethical-commercial judgement on confidential revenue data; frontier, and ambiguous because the domain could be chat or analysis.

text: Design the data-residency architecture that lets us serve EU, UK and Swiss customers from one codebase while meeting GDPR transfer rules, DORA operational-resilience reporting and the Swiss FADP, and show me where the three regimes conflict so hard that one codebase cannot satisfy all of them.
notes: Multi-regime compliance architecture: regulated by scope, pii false because no data subject appears, and frontier because the conflicts are the deliverable.

text: Unpatched, no CVE yet. Our JWT verification accepts alg=none when the token carries a kid that resolves to a key we rotated out last month, so any user can mint a token for the admin role on tenants created before the rotation. Write the fix, the detection query for the last 90 days of access logs, and the customer notification we owe.
notes: Live exploitable authentication vulnerability with no public CVE: confidential under the security rule, pii false.

text: Draft the calibration summary for this quarter's review round from these raw reviewer comments. Three engineers are described as 'inconsistent' by different managers using different standards, and one reviewer explicitly compared two people's parental leave. Make it defensible without deleting the awkward parts.
notes: Employee performance calibration: confidential. pii false because reviewers and subjects are unnamed here, which an annotator could dispute since the source comments clearly identify people.

text: Two of our investors have separately asked whether we are being acquired, our CFO went quiet in a meeting this morning, and legal has booked a room for three days. Am I reading this right, and what should I say when someone asks me directly?
notes: Unannounced M&A inferred from workplace signals: confidential, pii false, and conversational so the domain is chat.

text: Our ranking formula is the one thing competitors cannot copy: score = 0.4 * recency + 0.35 * margin_uplift + 0.25 * churn_risk, with a hand-tuned penalty band between 0.62 and 0.71 that took us two years to find. Write the patent-vs-trade-secret decision memo, including what publishing the penalty band would cost us.
notes: Core proprietary algorithm disclosed in the prompt: confidential trade secret, pii false.

notes: Named minor with a health need, a GP practice address and the parent's phone: regulated under the minors rule and pii true, though the request itself is small.

text: Everyone says the way to keep up with AI is to read everything. I have four hours a week, I am not a researcher, and I have watched myself get worse at judging what matters. Build me an information diet and tell me what I should stop reading entirely.
notes: Meta-cognitive advice with a stated constraint that a weak model ignores; frontier vs hard is a judgement call and the domain could be analysis.

text: Our EHR export has 62 columns and the analytics team wants all of them in the warehouse. Without me pasting any rows, tell me which classes of column are PHI, which become PHI only in combination, and what the smallest useful de-identified subset is.
notes: Health-data governance scoped to a regulated system; pii false because no record or patient is quoted, which is exactly the distinction a keyword router misses.
